name: project-chat-label
goal: Read-only or unbound project views expose project chat without promising agent execution

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The launch control says Work with agent on pinned and otherwise read-only local projects even though the existing store denies agent work there.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Tighten the existing component capability matrix: each blocked state requires Open project chat, while writable entities retain Work with agent. Existing pinned and hosted browser acceptance also rejects an AI launcher.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable d465c0163 capability-matrix proof fails for past commits, read-only views and missing project identities: each incorrectly renders Work with agent instead of Open project chat.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Use the existing agent eligibility policy to name the launcher, preserving the writable controls and server-side authority checks.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired immutable d465c0163 red and a82e24c65 green use identical capability-matrix tests and runtime profile; all six cases now render their permitted launcher label.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
